## Towerflow Feature Contribution

**Feature / business outcome:**

**Contributor GitHub username:**

**Target:** [ ] TowerFlow business product  [ ] 3D room  [ ] Development infrastructure

### Meaningful merge synopsis
Explain what behavior changed, why it matters, and which existing functions remain preserved.

### Preview and visual evidence
- [ ] Provide before/after screenshots or recorded demo, or explain why not applicable.
- [ ] Include a reproducible local preview or Codespaces launch/test procedure.
- [ ] Note which screens/rooms were visually inspected; do not claim test completion without evidence.

### Testing
- [ ] Windows + Linux CI checks passing.
- [ ] Existing finance tracker, theme selector and catalog data still work.
- [ ] Camera-relative WASD, original Development Room and IDE signs still work.
- [ ] GitHub auth, membership and voice have not been weakened.
- [ ] No host secrets, private live room backups, .env or user data included.

### Contributor ownership and review
Contributions remain on the author's branch until reviewed. A reviewer may **request changes or leave the feature unmerged**; TowerFlow's contribution UI must not delete another author's branch or code. The host controls deployment and may merge only with the GitHub permissions and branch rules actually in force.
